Leeds United defeats Newcastle United 4-1 in Premier League match

Leeds United secured a decisive 4-1 victory over Newcastle United at Elland Road in a Premier League match. The win propelled Leeds United to third place in the league standings. Anthony Elanga's injury status was also a point of discussion following the match.
